욥기 28:1.content: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

욥기 28:2.content: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

욥기 28:3.content: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

욥기 28:4.content: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

욥기 28:5.content: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

욥기 28:6.content: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

욥기 28:7.content: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:

욥기 28:8.content: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

욥기 28:9.content: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

욥기 28:10.content: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

욥기 28:11.content: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

욥기 28:12.content: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

욥기 28:13.content: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

욥기 28:14.content: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

욥기 28:15.content: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

욥기 28:16.content: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

욥기 28:17.content: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

욥기 28:18.content: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

욥기 28:19.content: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

욥기 28:20.content: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

욥기 28:21.content: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

욥기 28:22.content: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

욥기 28:23.content: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

욥기 28:24.content: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

욥기 28:25.content: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

욥기 28:26.content: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

욥기 28:27.content: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

욥기 28:28.content: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
